purpose: Placement-oracle strength benchmark; not a curriculum experiment
piece_randomization: independent uniform draws from I,O,T,S,Z,J,L using Python random.Random; identical saved stream per matched pair

policies.reference: simulator-native Dellacherie/Thiery-style rich afterstate evaluation with deterministic depth-2 beam expectimax

primary_measure: successful placements before top-out, administratively censored at 500
uncertainty: paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 2026082303
strength_criterion: PASS only if expert mean placements is at least 1.50 times legacy mean AND the paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for relative mean improvement exceeds 0.20
criterion_rationale: Requires both a large point improvement and uncertainty excluding a trivial gain; significance alone is insufficient.
runtime_pilot_rule: Time 3 games at the registered settings without inspecting performance summaries. If projected wall time exceeds 30 minutes, first reduce matched games to 50; if still projected above 30 minutes, reduce second-ply beam width from 6 to 3. Record any change before the benchmark outcome is summarized.
representative_example_rule: first 8 policy disagreements in game/placement order plus the first 2 agreements after those; no visual-quality filtering
